subject.title: [Android] camera.snap missing, location.get not implemented, canvas.present broken on v2026.6.11

question: Should follow-up preserve the current gateway.nodes.allowCommands and node-approval gates while investigating Android advertising/A2UI readiness, or intentionally change Android camera/location command exposure policy?
rationale: Camera and location expose sensitive device data, and current source shows both implementations and security gates; changing exposure policy is not safe for automation to decide from this report alone.

options.title: Verify and preserve gates
options.body: Run Android live proof, keep camera.snap/camera.clip behind explicit gateway.nodes.allowCommands, and fix only confirmed advertising, reapproval, settings, or A2UI readiness defects.

options.title: Change exposure policy
options.body: Broaden Android camera or location command exposure only with explicit security/product approval, docs updates, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Split after repro
options.body: If live proof shows independent camera, location, and A2UI causes, split the work into separate owner-reviewed issues or PRs.

recommendation.title: Verify and preserve gates
recommendation.body: Run Android live proof, keep camera.snap/camera.clip behind explicit gateway.nodes.allowCommands, and fix only confirmed advertising, reapproval, settings, or A2UI readiness defects.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision is primarily Android app behavior plus sensitive node command exposure, and the Android README names obviyus for Android app issues.
